misses.counterfactual_theory: An immutable record linking each forecast’s original specification, issuance time, evidence cutoff, and eligible realized outcome would make it possible to assess whether a forecast miss occurred. The supplied settlement prices alone do not establish that any forecast was wrong or late.
misses.decision_relevance: The registry identifies missing forecast contents and timing provenance as an auditability gap. Settlement records provide target-time prices but cannot be compared with absent forecast specifications.
misses.miss_description: Forecast-miss status is undetermined: the supplied evidence contains confirmed target-time BTC and ETH prices, but no qualifying pre-outcome forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff linked to those outcomes. This supports a data gap only, not a demonstrated decision failure.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked realized outcomes are absent, preventing ex-ante alignment and miss assessment.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records, including EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36; these provide target-time prices, not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
